doc.title: Billy Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, November 16, 1995

title: After Basie: fixing pool tables
summary: After leaving he lost contacts and worked fixing pool tables briefly.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: When you were, after you left the Basie band you worked mostly with small groups?

After I left the Basie band I was fixing pool tables. ‘Cause when anybody would see me on the street they’d say, “Hey man, I didn’t know the band was in town.” When I left the Basie band I’d been in big bands for five years so all contacts and things here — so when I left the band I put on a pair of overalls. That didn’t last long.
